purpose: Compare the existing captured-hardware aperture with a centered upright rounded rectangle that preserves access around both controls and supports the now-confirmed edge-flush foam.
baseline: F005 aperture retained historically in CB01 and LOC01. The old opening is a buffered convex hull of selected forward scan surfaces, not a factory-required contour or demonstrated handle fit.

inner_outline.corner_status: Assumed reference shape; not physically measured
inner_outline.center: Existing resolved inner_center_mm; physical alignment remains unverified
inner_outline.rotation_status: Upright in installed XY, consistent with the existing inner reference; not an accepted physical registration

foam.outer_inset_status: User confirms foam meets outer metal edge
foam.width_status: Approximate; no minimum local width or compression tolerance established

upright_trial.land_status: Geometric remainder under the assumed corner contour and uniform band, not an approved tolerance or sealing allowance
upright_trial.reason: Encloses the entire previous buffered aperture while opening space around both controls. Keep locating and retaining the plate as a separate unresolved requirement.

outputs.diverter: Unchanged CB01 companion; no new diverter fit claim
outputs.export_frame: Local origin at main circular outline/inner reference center; +X right, +Y up, +Z outward; rear metal face Z=0

control_checks.interpretation: Project these measured opening footprints at the existing reference placement. They are not measurements of adapter outside diameter, hub outside diameter or minimum engagement.
control_checks.lower_opening: Actual diameter remains unmeasured; show the existing 50 mm inner-reference assumption separately.
control_checks.axis_note: Original scan tip centers and reference opening centers remain distinct. Six caliper tip-to-tip distances remain 3D constraints, not XY hole coordinates.

manufacturer_interface.sequence: Adapters attach to stems; inner plate fits over studs; decorative cover is retained by handle assemblies threaded onto inner-plate hubs. Correct adapter length is needed for engagement and seating.
manufacturer_interface.implication: The complete knobs install from the front, not through the custom backing aperture. Rearward-reaching adapters/hubs, axial insertion and engagement still require actual clearance.

selection: Recommended next dry-fit candidate; no physical design selection or fabrication release
limits: Captured-surface clearance does not bound hidden hardware or scan error.
Full factory-opening footprint clearance is stronger than a center point but is not a physical handle fit.
Added plate and bedding shift the factory assembly relative to fixed stems; no unmeasured spline/thread overlap is inferred.
Wood relief permits stud retraction but does not correct valve or stem depth.
New aperture does not select material, finish, support, sealing, retention or machining tolerances.
